description: Label Render. Render a previously saved label by ID. Public, no API key required. Supports ?format= override.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

format.description: Override output format. Allowed values: svg, png. Default: "svg".
